mapper.select:
SELECT a.msg_id AS id, a.transaction_id, a.msg_type AS type, a.role, b.msg_text AS content, b.ext_params FROM bt_bot_session_msg a JOIN bt_bot_session_msg_text b ON a.msg_id = b.msg_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND a.msg_type IN ('general', 'a2ui', 'page', 'pageFunc') AND (a.compressed IS NULL OR a.compressed = 'F')
AND a.context_id IS NULL
AND a.context_id = #{contextId}
ORDER BY a.sort

SELECT a.msg_id AS id, a.ref_msg_id AS ref_id, a.bot_id, a.transaction_id, a.context_id, a.scene_id, a.plan_id, a.msg_type AS type, a.role, b.msg_text AS content, b.download_type, b.content_type, b.paragraph_group, b.paragraph_sortby, a.like_type, a.begin_time, a.end_time, b.ext_params, a.feedback_reason, a.sort FROM bt_bot_session_msg a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_session_msg_text b ON a.msg_id = b.msg_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A'
AND a.msg_type NOT IN ('point', 'pageFunc', 'questions', 'exception') AND (a.plan_id IS NULL OR a.msg_type = 'confirmPlan') AND a.transaction_id IN (#{id})
AND a.like_type = #{query.likeType}
AND a.like_type IS NULL
ORDER BY a.sort

SELECT a.msg_id AS id, a.ref_msg_id AS ref_id, a.bot_id, a.transaction_id, a.context_id, a.scene_id, a.plan_id, a.msg_type AS type, a.role, b.msg_text AS content, b.download_type, b.content_type, b.paragraph_group, b.paragraph_sortby, a.like_type, a.begin_time, a.end_time, b.ext_params, a.sort FROM bt_bot_session_msg a LEFT JOIN bt_bot_session_msg_text b ON a.msg_id = b.msg_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.content_type = 'paragraph' AND a.transaction_id IN (#{id})
SELECT MAX(a.sort) FROM bt_bot_session_msg a WHERE a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND a.status_cd = '00A'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bt_bot_session_msg WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND context_id = #{contextId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS existence
